aside.point1: Projects, tasks and documents your whole team can trust.
aside.point2: A calm portal where clients send requests and approve work.
aside.point3: Reports built only from what actually happened.

name: Your name
passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A short sentence works well.
forgotBody: Enter the email you use for Orqivanta. If there’s an account, we’ll send a link to choose a new password.

forgotSent.title: Check your email
forgotSent.body: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way. It works for one hour.

resetBody: Signing in with the new password also signs out your other devices.
agree: By creating an account you agree to the <terms>Terms</terms> and <privacy>Privacy notice</privacy>.
inviteEmailHint: Use the address your invitation was sent to.

verify.title: Check your email
verify.sentBody: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to finish creating your account.
verify.unverifiedBody: Your email {email} isn’t confirmed yet. We’ve sent a fresh link.
verify.confirmBody: One click and your account is ready.
verify.expiredHelp: Links work once and expire after a day. Sign in to get a new one.

devMailboxHint: Running locally? Emails are captured in the

linkExpired.title: This link has expired
linkExpired.body: Links from emails work once and for a limited time.
linkExpired.resetBody: Password reset links work once and expire after an hour. Ask for a new one below.
linkExpired.inviteBody: Ask the person who invited you to send a new invitation.

demoBody: Explore a sample studio workspace as a producer, a designer or a client. No sign-up needed.

demo.title: Explore the demo
demo.subtitle: Pick a role. You’ll enter Northwind Studio, a fictional agency with six weeks of sample work.
demo.disclaimer: Everything in the demo is made up, including the people, clients and email addresses. The workspace is reset regularly, so feel free to change things.

priya.label: Producer
priya.description: Runs projects, triages client requests and reads the reports.

leo.label: Designer
leo.description: Works through assigned tasks and has a review waiting.

hannah.label: Client
hannah.description: Uses the client portal to approve designs and send requests.

invite.title: Join {org}
invite.subtitle: {inviter} invited {email} to join as {role}.
invite.wrongAccount: You’re signed in as {current}, but this invitation is for {invited}.

invalid.title: This invitation doesn’t work
invalid.body: The link may be incomplete. Ask for a new invitation.

expired.title: This invitation has expired
expired.body: Invitations to {org} last seven days. Ask for a new one.

revoked.title: This invitation was withdrawn
revoked.body: An admin at {org} cancelled it. Ask them if you still need access.

accepted.title: Already accepted
accepted.body: This invitation to {org} has been used. Sign in to continue.

twoFactor.title: Enter your code
twoFactor.subtitle: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for Orqivanta.
twoFactor.recoveryHint: Looks like abcde-fghij. Each code works once.
